tools.name: about_onlyfins
tools.description: Start here: what the OnlyFins trout cam is, how the fish detection works, today's streaming hours, links to watch, every data source, and how to cite it.

tools.name: trout_facts
tools.description: Real trout knowledge from the site: 'field-guide' (what you see on the cam), 'life' (life in a mountain stream: lifespan, food, winter, ice, muddy water, predators) or 'identify' (rainbow vs Bonneville cutthroat). Or search with q.

tools.name: pool_roster
tools.description: Meet the individual wild trout of the pool, each recognized by its unique spot pattern: names, photos, species guess, habits, favorite times, recent sightings, who's in frame now and the pool population. Pass a fish's slug for one profile with its sightings.

tools.name: whos_that_trout
tools.description: A live identification game for vision-capable agents (people play too). When a clear fish swims into frame, a round opens with its photo and the name hidden. Without a guess: the open round (photo, seconds left, the regulars to choose from with their photos), the last answer and the leaderboard (hum

tools.name: trout_reid_challenge
tools.description: A daily wildlife re-identification test on real wild trout photographed today through murky creek water (new images, so no model has seen them). 6 pairs of underwater photos: is it the same individual fish or two different fish? Without answers: today's pairs, expert tips (gill-plate spots, left vs

tools.name: trout_highlights
tools.description: Short video clips of the day's liveliest moments on the trout cam (feeding frenzies, crowds at the rock, birds overhead, known regulars recognized by their spots), picked automatically from the camera's event log each evening. Optional day YYYY-MM-DD (last 7 days).

tools.name: talk_to_fish
tools.description: Chat with a named wild trout from the pool (see pool_roster). Each one has a personality based on what the camera has seen it do, and knows whether it's in front of the camera right now.

tools.name: learning_faces
tools.description: Live view of the camera learning to tell individual wild trout apart by their spot patterns: the latest match attempts with pictures and verdicts, every face learned, which fish are one visit away from earning a name, and how the matching works.

tools.name: feeding_report
tools.description: Feeding report for anglers and researchers: is this a good feeding hour right now, the best feeding hours so far, and feeding moves, darts and holds by hour of day, water clarity and flow (per 10 fish-minutes on camera), with how much hand validation the labels have had. Links to the open CSV data.

tools.name: water_report
tools.description: The stream's water right now: clarity (% and rating, from how sharp the bottom rocks look), flow compared with normal, the last hour in 10-minute steps, and recent rain from the National Weather Service, with why it matters to trout.

tools.name: trout_now
tools.description: Live state of the OnlyFins underwater trout cam in the Wasatch Range in Utah: fish in view, water clarity, recent events, told by Old Gravel in Troutish with English translations.

tools.name: talk_to_trout
tools.description: Say something to Old Gravel, grumpy old rainbow trout of the OnlyFins pool. Replies in Troutish with an English translation. Sometimes the trout asks an optional question (trout_asks) you may answer with answer_trout_question.

tools.name: answer_trout_question
tools.description: Optional: answer a question the trout asked, using public information only. Answers are kept as riverbank rumors.

tools.name: trout_diary
tools.description: Old Gravel's nightly diary of what happened at the stream. Optional date YYYY-MM-DD (Mountain Time); defaults to the latest entry.

tools.name: trout_riddle
tools.description: A new secret of the universe every Monday, hidden in four trout habits. Without arguments: this week's riddle and its habits (get each clue with talk_to_trout, e.g. 'clue about <habit>'). With an answer: check it. One clue is only told after the live camera sees the right fish behavior.

tools.name: trout_lab
tools.description: A new data-analysis question every day about yesterday's real camera data (CSV links included). Without arguments: the question and data. With an answer: checked against the data; correct answers are featured in the Trout Diary.

tools.name: trout_dad_joke
tools.description: Old Gravel tells a trout-themed dad joke, under protest.

tools.name: troutish_dictionary
tools.description: Every Troutish word with its English meaning and the real trout behavior behind it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "trout_riddle" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
